A.existing_action_pairs: Reuse all original frozen roots, branches and actual-history-oracle; no recollection
A.new_inputs: Minimal variable-human relation/attention/maxpool preserving 256 dimensions and weights; N=5 exact gate
A.readouts: Case-grouped train/dev/test across seeds, fixed latent capacity and optimizer budget, MC versus pair-supervision and TTC5 versus legal all-human representation. Diagnostic fit only, not navigation IL/RL or OOD evidence.
A.closed_loop: Fixed root sequence, replay A0 before intervention; same commands, safety, reward; success controls mandatory for protected-benefit claims
A.hidden_intent: Artificial hidden-goal intervention, root-visible history and scores unchanged; separate from natural conditional expected-Q conclusions
A.GO: Specific intervention improves held-out ranking and actual continuation without success destruction; only bounded development eligibility, not method-level achievement
A.KILL: No outcome benefit or benefit matched by simple control; do not revive rejected AC3/gap/backbone routes
